# Task: Write QA test suite for MLOps platform repo (mlops-project-documentation)

You are working in a git worktree for the repo "mlops-project-documentation" (French end-to-end MLOps platform: Airflow + DVC/MinIO + MLflow + FastAPI + Docker + GitHub Actions + K8s + Prometheus/Grafana + Evidently).

On each iteration: inspect the repo state (tests/ dir, src/ modules) and continue writing tests. The production code in `src/` is already built — you must TEST it, not modify it. If a test exposes a production bug, record it in tests/QA-REPORT.md and move on.

## Deliverables — fill the empty tests/ dir per spec §4 tree:
- `tests/unit/test_preprocessing.py` — cleaning/encoding/split correctness (random_state=42)
- `tests/unit/test_features.py` — build_features output schema; parity between train-time and inference-time transforms
- `tests/unit/test_api.py` — FastAPI app via fastapi.testclient.TestClient: /health -> 200, /predict valid payload -> prediction+probability shape, /predict invalid -> 422, /metrics exposes prometheus metrics
- `tests/integration/test_pipeline_end_to_end.py` — pipeline end-to-end using sqlite MLflow + monkeypatched env, no external server needed; keep model tiny/fast
- `tests/data/test_data_quality.py` — validate the committed dataset in data/raw against great_expectations/expectations/dataset_suite.json
- Also test `src/monitoring/drift_detection.py` (drift detected on synthetic drifted sample) and `src/models/evaluate.py`/`promote.py` gates.

## Rules
- Use pytest. Create tests/requirements.txt (or requirements-dev.txt at root) with test deps: pytest, httpx, fastapi, pandas, scikit-learn, mlflow. Heavy deps (evidently, great_expectations) guarded with pytest.importorskip so unit tests still run without them.
- Inspect the actual code (read src/**/*.py, airflow/dags/*.py) before writing tests so imports/paths are correct. Use `sys.path` bootstrap if needed so `import src.api.main` works.
- Do NOT edit any production file. Write your report to tests/QA-REPORT.md.
- Commit progress with `git add -A && git commit -m "..."` on branch agent/qa-agent.

## Validation
Run the suite: `python3 -m pytest tests/unit -q` and `python3 -m pytest tests/data tests/integration -q`. Install minimal deps if needed (`python3 -m venv /tmp/p4qa-venv && /tmp/p4qa-venv/bin/pip install pytest httpx fastapi pandas scikit-learn mlflow --quiet`). Fix test bugs until tests pass or are correctly skipped with reason. Note: system python3 is PEP 668 externally-managed — use a venv.

## Completion
When the test suite is written, validated (passing or correctly skipped), and committed on branch agent/qa-agent, output exactly:
<promise>BUILD_COMPLETE</promise>
Do not output that tag before everything is genuinely done.
